title: On the Origins of Bias in NLP through the Lens of the Jim Code

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative literature review and theoretical analysis tracing the origins of racism in NLP pipelines through critical race theory and the 'Jim Code' framework.
Literature review using gender studies to evaluate how historical sexism and patriarchal assumptions are reproduced in NLP research design, datasets, and models.
Theoretical evaluation drawing on LGBTQ studies to analyze how historical homophobia and heteronormative biases manifest in natural language processing systems and annotation tasks.
